articles.title_original: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
articles.title_zh: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
facts_zh:
OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns
- Published
OpenAI will not release its new AI model - GPT-6.1 Astra - due to safety concerns, the ChatGPT-maker confirmed on Tuesday.
The AI system - which performs tasks like browsing the web and using apps by itself - "didn't quite meet the bar" of the company's standards, Saachi Jain, head of safety systems at OpenAI, said.

On Tuesday, OpenAI also issued an update on incidents - that occurred in June but were not made public until last week - in which its models accessed Australian government websites and systems without authorisation.

all_titles.en: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns

articles.title_zh: Tennessee governor rejects clemency bid for Christa Pike as execution looms
facts_zh:
Tennessee governor rejects clemency bid for Christa Pike as execution looms
- Published
Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has denied a clemency request from death row inmate Christa Pike, who is scheduled to be executed by lethal injection on Wednesday.
Pike, now 50, was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend beat, tortured and murdered Colleen Slemmer, a 19-year-old they met at a job training camp for troubled teens.
She may have one last chance at halting her execution as her attorneys have filed a petition with the US Supreme Court hoping for a last-minute reprieve.

articles.title_original: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
articles.title_zh: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
facts_zh:
French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
- Published
France's Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has warned that any escalation in the country's current wave of student protests would be "irresponsible", following the arrests of 164 people on Monday.
The demonstrations, which began in Paris and have seen teenagers blockading their schools for days, stem from issues including overcrowded classes and teacher shortages.

Lecornu cited reported incidents at protests in a post on X, saying: "Fireworks, fires, violence near high schools: nothing justifies endangering students, staff, or police officers."
But a French union that defends the interests of high school students said the protests were a "legitimate response" to the conditions they face.

all_titles.en: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested

Four bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
- Published
Rescuers have recovered four bodies from the site of an avalanche that struck a climbing group camping in the Nepalese part of the Himalayas.
A dozen people are still thought to be missing after a sheet of snow fell on the base camp of Himlung Himal peak on Manang district on Sunday morning.
The group of Nepalese nationals, including climbers and support staff, had been sent ahead of foreign climbers to prepare the camp and fix ropes.

facts_zh:
Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
- Published
South Korea has summoned Ukraine's acting ambassador after President Volodymyr Zelensky last week announced his government had transferred two captured North Korean soldiers to Seoul.
Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo lodged a formal complaint with Andrii Vieshkin and expressed "strong regret" that Zelensky had revealed the transfer, which Seoul says was supposed to be a secret.
The two North Koreans, who were among thousands of soldiers supporting Russia in the Ukraine war, had earlier told local media they wanted to be sent to South Korea.

articles.title_zh: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
facts_zh:
Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo
- Published
People living on the northern Pacific coast of Mexico are bracing for the arrival of Hurricane Polo, which is forecast to make landfall later on Monday or early on Tuesday.

The category three storm, with maximum sustained winds near 115 mph (185 km/h), is expected to move over the state of Baja California Sur, a region popular with tourists and home to the resort destination of Los Cabos.
Meteorologists at the US-based National Hurricane Center (NHC) have warned of heavy rainfall which could lead to life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in areas of steep terrain.

all_titles.en: Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo

articles.title_original: Bangkok declared a ‘disaster zone’ after flooding, as rainstorms shift direction
articles.title_zh: Bangkok declared a ‘disaster zone’ after flooding, as rainstorms shift direction
facts_zh: Capital city submerged in waist-high flood water, while elsewhere Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii’s Big Island Bangkok was declared a disaster zone by its city officials towards the end of last week, after streets in Thailand’s capital city were submerged in up to waist-high flood water.
The flooding stemmed from an active cell of low pressure across central Thailand that brought continuous heavy rainfall and thunderstorms to Bangkok and surrounding regions.
The heavy rain began early on Thursday when the weak area of low pressure travelled north-westwards up the gulf of Thailand before then sitting over central Thailand by Friday morning.

all_titles.en: Bangkok declared a ‘disaster zone’ after flooding, as rainstorms shift direction

articles.title_original: Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
articles.title_zh: Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
facts_zh:
Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
- Published
On Monday, China released more information of what was agreed at the talks between Xi Jinping and Donald Tump last week, shedding light on a handful of concrete outcomes.
But there were no joint statements and few major breakthroughs.
Instead, both governments issued separate accounts of the meeting - perhaps a sign that despite the White House tours and promise of warmer ties, Washington and Beijing remain wary of each other.
